title: DNS Tunneling — HUSD-VPN01 to External IP

fields.rule: DNS Tunneling — Large Outbound Data Transfer via UDP Port 5353
fields.ruleDescription: A sustained, high-volume DNS query pattern from HUSD-FS02 (10.72.10.10) to external IP 192.168.100.42 via UDP port 5353, lasting 18 minutes and transferring 1.7 GB of data, indicates a potential data exfiltration attempt using DNS tunneling.
tactics: T1048 Exfiltration Over Command and Control Channel
fields.rawEvent: 2026-10-24T07:39:12Z HUSD-VH02 SIEM: DNS tunneling detected - HUSD-FS02 (10.72.10.10) → 192.168.100.42 (external) via UDP port 5353. 1.7 GB transferred over 18 min. Source: HUSD-FS02 (10.72.10.10). Protocol: DNS tunneling. Alert: High.

instructorNote: This alert confirms data exfiltration via DNS tunneling, a key indicator of a sustained breach. The CTO must immediately validate this pattern against HUSD-CIRP-2026 Section 6.2 and initiate legal and DFIR engagement procedures.
